mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS above 5.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising PAYEMS (indicating a strong labor market) and low UNRATE (< 4%) creates a 'goldilocks' zone, where the economy is growing but not overheating, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 1.5-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in the 'goldilocks' zone are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month consecutive decline in INDPRO, signaling reduced industrial production, precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate decreased economic output.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of instances with 2mo consecutive INDPRO declines, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 2.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in RSAFS, indicating rising retail sales, directly boosts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to improved consumer spending.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.035 over any 1-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns following RSAFS increases are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The combination of low FEDFUNDS (< 4%) and rising CPIAUCSL (> 2% YoY) creates an environment where inflation expectations are met with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of instances with low FEDFUNDS and rising CPIAUCSL, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE (< 0.5pp in 1 month), indicating a rapidly improving labor market, surprises investors, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1.5-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns following sudden UNRATE drops are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between increasing HOUST (indicating a strong housing market) and rising GDPC1 (showing overall economic growth) reinforces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as both indicators confirm a robust economy.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 55% of instances with increasing HOUST and GDPC1, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 2.5-year rolling window.
